lede: The biggest item this week is Town Council's June 30 meeting, where first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's Wildfire Resiliency Code will set the terms for how development and fire risk coexist in this canyon going forward — worth your attention. The Telluride Hospital District board also meets June 25 to dig into mill levy considerations, a recurring pressure point as the hospital pushes toward a new facility. Meanwhile, P&Z holds a work session Thursday on the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment Project, the major Town-owned site proposal that's been generating plenty of conversation.

notable.stake: Mill levy discussion directly affects how the hospital district is funded.
Early shaping of a major Town-owned redevelopment before formal Land Use Code review.
First reading of wildfire code amendments will govern development and fire risk for years.
